lines.en: label yasuchristmalloween1:
scene yasuquietroom1
: Io, can I ask you a question?
lines.zh: : Io，我能问你个问题吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不能。

lines.en: : Okay. Well, I’m going to do it anyway. Why does your Christmalloween costume make me so sad, yet also fill me with desire to ruffle your hair and call you a good girl?
lines.zh: : 好。那我还是要问。为什么你的圣诞万圣装扮让我这么难过，同时又让我满心想要揉乱你的头发、夸你是个好女孩？

lines.en: : Likely because I’ve finally found the right blend between pitiful and cute. And that this is probably the most festive I’ve looked since I was an employee at Lawson.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为我终于找到了「可怜」和「可爱」之间的正确配比。而且这大概是我自从在罗森打工以来最有节日气氛的样子。

lines.en: : Can I ask you a question now?
lines.zh: : 那现在我能问你个问题吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 可以。

lines.en: : What are you even supposed to be?
lines.zh: : 你到底扮的是什么？

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom2
: I think her name is Ryza or something? I don’t really know, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 我想她好像叫 Ryza 什么的？说实话我不太清楚。

lines.en: : I’m just throwing more darts at the millennial dart board to try and appeal to Sensei in hopes that I stop being shafted every Christmalloween and that he finally shafts me in the {i}good{/i} way.
lines.zh: : 我只是又往千禧年飞镖盘上多扔几支镖，想讨 Sensei 欢心，好让我别每个圣诞万圣都被冷落，让他终于用「{i}好{/i}的方式」对我。

lines.en: : Uta, what does it mean to be “shafted?”
lines.zh: : Uta，「被冷落」是什么意思？

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom3
: Ignore me, Yasuyasu. That doesn’t mean anything. I’m just letting my emotions get the best of me again.
lines.zh: : 别理我，Yasuyasu。那没什么意思。我只是又让情绪占了上风。

lines.en: : Can I ask another question while we’re setting the table for this scene in a mostly figurative manner, yet also slightly literally since we just covered it with cookies and soda?
lines.zh: : 趁我们（多半是比喻意义上）给这场戏摆桌子的时候，我能再问个问题吗？不过也稍微有点字面意义，毕竟我们刚在上面摆满了饼干和汽水。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom4
: Yes!
lines.zh: : 可以！

lines.en: : Why is {i}she{/i} here?
lines.zh: : {i}她{/i}为什么在这儿？

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom5
: Because the other room was too busy! Right, Yasuyasu?
lines.zh: : 因为另一个房间太吵了！对吧，Yasuyasu？

lines.en: : Right! It’s hard enough going to school and hearing the unseen orchestra of everyone’s blood. But it’s even harder at parties when the blood moves faster and sounds more like the inside of a demon’s intestines.
lines.zh: : 对！光是上学、听着所有人血液里那支看不见的交响乐就已经够难了。派对上更难——血流得更快，听起来更像恶魔肠子里面的声音。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom6
: There’s your answer, Io. Demon intestines. You got a problem with that?
lines.zh: : 这就是你的答案，Io。恶魔肠子。你有意见？

lines.en: : Not particularly. I just assumed that I’d be the only one hanging out in the quiet room and that you’d show up intermittently to say hi because you feel bad about me being alone.
lines.zh: : 没什么特别的。我只是以为安静房间里只有我一个人，你会时不时过来打个招呼，因为你会因为让我一个人待着而内疚。

lines.en: : That will still happen, I’m sure. There’s an adult I need to go seduce before ultimately backing out because hormones and history have combined to make me question every feeling I ever have.
lines.zh: : 那还是会发生的，我确信。而且有个成年人我得先去勾引，最后再因为荷尔蒙和过往联手让我质疑自己的每一种感情而临阵退缩。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom7
: But you’ll have Yasu in the meantime because Touka isn’t here today! Yay! For the Yasu thing. Not the Touka thing.
lines.zh: : 不过这段时间你有 Yasu 陪着，因为 Touka 今天不在！耶！是为 Yasu 那件事欢呼。不是为 Touka 不在欢呼。

lines.en: : Yay!
scene yasuquietroom8
: I understand that you do not like me — or girls at all, for that matter — so I promise to be as normal as I possibly can today in hopes that we can be friends.
lines.zh: : 我知道你不喜欢我——或者说不喜欢女孩——所以我保证今天尽量正常一点，希望我们能做朋友。

lines.en: : Well, as long as you know.
lines.zh: : 嗯，只要你明白就好。

lines.en: : Io! Surely you can muster a nicer response to Yasuyasu wanting to be friends with you than that!
lines.zh: : Io！Yasuyasu 想跟你做朋友，你肯定能给出比那好听点的回应吧！

lines.en: : I really don’t understand why you keep putting so much faith in me when I have done nothing to warrant or earn it.
lines.zh: : 我真不明白你为什么一直对我寄予厚望，明明我没做过任何配得上它、或者挣来它的事。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom9
: I’m sorry, Yasu. But if it makes you feel better, I’m your friend! I just also happen to be leaving you in a few minutes since I have a mission to commence.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Yasu。不过如果这能让你好受点——我是你的朋友！只是碰巧我几分钟后也要走了，因为我有个任务要开始。

lines.en: : There’s no need to apologize. I am fully aware of my unwantedness and thank all of you for merely existing in the same space as me as even that is more than I deserve.
lines.zh: : 没必要道歉。我完全清楚自己不受欢迎，也感谢你们所有人仅仅跟我存在于同一个空间——因为就连那都比我应得的多。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom10
: I think we might need to re-title the quiet room to the self-deprecation room if the trajectory of this conversation is at all indicative of what’s to come.
lines.zh: : 如果这场对话的走向真能预示接下来会怎样，那我们大概得把「安静房间」改名叫「自贬房间」了。

lines.en: : Yasu’s probably the only girl who can keep up with me when it comes to self-hate. And that’s saying a lot since both members of dorm four actively harm themselves.
lines.zh: : 说到自我厌恶，Yasu 大概是唯一能跟上我的女孩。考虑到四号宿舍那两位都在主动伤害自己，这话的分量可不轻。

lines.en: : Do we really need to bring that up right now? Christmalloween is all about having fun and spending time together!
lines.zh: : 我们现在真得提这个吗？圣诞万圣的意义是开心、是大家待在一起！

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom11
: ANYWAY, BYE!
lines.zh: : 总之，拜拜！

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom12
: Cool, yeah. I didn’t want you to say hi to him for me or anything. I’ll just hang out here with the evangelist. I’m sure that’ll go really well.
lines.zh: : 好，是啊。我本来也没指望你替我跟他打招呼什么的。我就跟这位布道者一起待在这儿。我确信那会非常顺利。

lines.en: : Uta’s aura seems particularly thick today. Is this mission of hers truly that important to her?
lines.zh: : Uta 今天的气场格外浓。她那个任务对她真有那么重要吗？

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom13
: Well, considering it’s the same mission like 75%% of our class has built themselves around, I’d say so. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 嗯，考虑到我们班大概 75% 的人都在围着同一个任务转，我会说是的。没错。

lines.en: : You mean the sinful and disgusting pursuit of sexual intercourse with our teacher that seems to govern and guide the decisions of those who have yet to be touched by the light?
lines.zh: : 你是指那种罪恶又恶心的追求——跟我们老师性交——它似乎在支配和引导那些还没被光照到的人所做的每一个决定？

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom14
: That’s actually a surprisingly adequate description when you leave out the stuff about “light” or whatever.
lines.zh: : 如果把「光」什么的那些东西去掉，这描述意外地挺到位的。

lines.en: : Do you not desire to bathe in the same waters of wretched behavior that everyone else does?
lines.zh: : 你就不想跟大家一样，在同一片堕落行为的水里泡一泡？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Is kissing and stuff part of those {i}waters?{/i}
lines.zh: : 不知道。接吻什么的算那片{i}水{/i}的一部分吗？

lines.en: : I think kissing is probably okay.
lines.zh: : 我觉得接吻大概没问题。

lines.en: : Then yeah. I think I’ll stay on land and let everyone else be eaten by sharks. I have no interest in that aspect of relationships.
lines.zh: : 那行。我想我还是待在陆地上，让别人去被鲨鱼吃掉吧。我对关系中那个部分没兴趣。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom15
: Yay! This means we can bond over our virginities together!
lines.zh: : 耶！那我们就可以一起因为都是处女而 bonding 了！

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m going to need you to, like...not ever say that again, please.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我得请你……永远别再这么说了，拜托。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom16
: Well, don’t look all {i}sad{/i} over it. I just don’t like that topic as a whole. We can still...talk about other shit so long as you don’t get all weird again. You haven’t been the worst so far.
lines.zh: : 别为这个一副{i}难过{/i}的样子。我只是整体上不喜欢那个话题。只要你别又变得怪怪的，我们还是可以……聊点别的。目前为止你还不算最糟。

lines.en: : I have a hard time not becoming “weird” according to everything I have heard from our peers.
lines.zh: : 按我从同龄人那儿听到的一切，我很难不变得「怪」。

lines.en: : Touka says the medication is supposed to help me with this, but I’m not sure how right she is if the threat of my transition still clings to the coattails of this conversation like spiders to their webs.
lines.zh: : Touka 说药应该能帮我改善这个，不过如果「我要转变」这个威胁还像蜘蛛粘在网上一样黏在这段对话的后摆上，我就不确定她有多对了。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom17
: You’re on medication now? Since when?
lines.zh: : 你现在在吃药？从什么时候开始的？

lines.en: : Um...perhaps since...last Christmalloween? I don’t really remember...
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概从……去年圣诞万圣？我不太记得了……

lines.en: : Is not remembering a side-effect of your medication, maybe? What are you taking? Some sort of anti-psychotic?
lines.zh: : 记不住也许是药的副作用？你在吃什么？某种抗精神病药？

lines.en: : I just...take whatever I am given. I’m not sure {i}what{/i} it is.
lines.zh: : 我……给我{i}什么{/i}就吃什么。我不确定那是什么。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom18
: You should really try and find out. I don’t trust anyone enough to blindly consume whatever I’m given without doing proper research first. You should be the same.
lines.zh: : 你真该去查清楚。我谁都不信到会不做足功课就盲目吞下别人给我的东西。你也应该这样。

lines.en: : I think there are certain things that are simply beyond my understanding. And Touka won’t hurt me, so I think it’s okay to trust her...
lines.zh: : 我想有些事本来就超出我的理解范围。而且 Touka 不会伤害我，所以我觉得信任她没问题……

lines.en: : Life lesson, Yasu — you never know {i}who{/i} is going to hurt you. And you can’t know {i}why{/i} either because, sometimes, there’s no reason at all. Sometimes, people just {i}want{/i} to hurt others.
lines.zh: : 人生一课，Yasu——你永远不知道{i}谁{/i}会伤害你。你也没法知道{i}为什么{/i}，因为有时候根本没有理由。有时候，人就是{i}想{/i}伤害别人。

lines.en: : You’re a vulnerable girl. There’s no way around it. They can drug you with whatever they want and have complete control over you if you don’t take matters into your own hands and fight back.
lines.zh: : 你是个容易受伤的女孩。这没法回避。如果你不自己把事情掌握在手里、奋起反抗，他们想给你下什么药就下什么药，还能完全控制你。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom19
: What are you...suggesting I do then?
lines.zh: : 那你是……建议我怎么做？

lines.en: : A good place to start would be learning what you’re putting into your body at least. That way, you can make an informed decision about what’s right for {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 一个好的起点，至少是弄清楚你往身体里塞了什么。那样你才能就什么对{i}你{/i}是对的做出知情决定。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom20
: That is the aspect I understand the least...for all the things that seem right to me have been wrong to everyone else for as long as I can remember.
lines.zh: : 那正是我最不理解的部分……因为从我记事起，凡是让我觉得对的事，对别人来说都是错的。

lines.en: : Well, how about this? What’s your dream? What do you want to do? What’s something that would make {i}Yasu{/i} happy?
lines.zh: : 那这样如何？你的梦想是什么？你想做什么？有什么事能让 {i}Yasu{/i} 开心？

lines.en: : Safety from condemnation and a light that engulfs the world as we know it.
lines.zh: : 免于被定罪的安稳，以及吞没我们所知的这个世界的光。

lines.en: : Okay. Now, try that again, but say something that makes sense this time. Which I know you can. I’ve seen it happen before. Just be human.
lines.zh: : 好。现在再试一次，不过这次说点有意义的。我知道你能做到，我以前见过。就当个人吧。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom21
: Being human is hard when you are actually just a cockroach! No one will buy it no matter how hard I try!
lines.zh: : 当你其实只是一只蟑螂的时候，当人太难了！不管我怎么努力都没人买账！

lines.en: : {i}I’ll{/i} buy it. Just say something. What do you really want that’s {i}attainable?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}买账。就说点什么吧。你真正想要、而且{i}够得着{/i}的东西是什么？

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom22
: I would still like for you to be my friend.
lines.zh: : 我还是希望你能做我的朋友。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom18
: Pass. Anything else?
lines.zh: : 免了。还有别的吗？

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom23
: I do not belong in this world...
lines.zh: : 我不属于这个世界……

lines.en: : There’s no need to get offended. I already have two friends, which is honestly two more than I really want to be bothered with in the first place. There’s no way I could manage a third.
lines.zh: : 没必要觉得被冒犯。我已经有两个朋友了，说实话那已经比我一开始愿意被烦的数量多出两个了。第三个我可管不过来。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom24
: Besides, you don’t want a friend like me. Relationships are about mutual benefit and there is just literally nothing I can give you that you can’t get from anyone else.
lines.zh: : 再说，你也不会想要我这种朋友。关系讲的是互利，而我 literally 给不了你任何你从别人那儿得不到的东西。

lines.en: : But I {i}must{/i} become your friend if I am ever going to save you. That is my mission. And my mission must be completed if I am ever to become a-
lines.zh: : 可我{i}必须{/i}成为你的朋友，否则我就救不了你。那是我的使命。而我的使命必须完成，我才能成为一个——

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom25
: God isn’t real.
lines.zh: : 神不是真的。

lines.en: : Yes He is.
lines.zh: : 祂是真的。

lines.en: : {size=-3}You’re wrong. And this “mission” that you’ve deceived yourself into both following and believing in is little more than a delusion of grandeur no different from the stuff that white girl in our class yells about all day.{/i}
lines.zh: : {size=-3}你错了。而且你骗自己追随、又骗自己相信的这个「使命」，只不过是一种妄自尊大，跟我们班那个白人女孩整天吼的那些东西没两样。{/size}

lines.en: : He {i}is{/i} real, though. Sensei has seen Him and everything.
lines.zh: : 祂{i}是{/i}真的。Sensei 都见过祂什么的。

lines.en: : Sure. And I hold the record for the fastest pitch ever thrown in the NPB.
lines.zh: : 当然。顺便说一句，我还保持着 NPB 史上最快球速纪录呢。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom26
: That’s very impressive! Congratulations, Io!
lines.zh: : 那非常厉害啊！恭喜你，Io！

lines.en: : I can’t believe I deluded myself into thinking for a second that this conversation was actually going anywhere.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信我竟然一度自我欺骗，以为这场对话真能谈出什么结果。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom27
: Hi again! I brought Miku here in exchange for information on Sensei’s whereabouts. Now, please excuse me while I put my tracking skills to the test!
lines.zh: : 又见面了！我把 Miku 带来，换 Sensei 行踪的情报。现在，请原谅我，我要去考验一下我的追踪技术了！

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom28
: Uhh...hey. You don’t mind if I chill here for a little while, do ya? Ain’t really feelin’ the whole {i}noise{/i} thing tonight and Uta said you guys had a place I could kinda reset.
lines.zh: : 呃……嘿。我在这儿待一会儿你不介意吧？今晚真不太想凑那个{i}热闹{/i}，Uta 说你们这儿有地方能让我缓缓。

lines.en: : Can you, like...put a jacket on or something first? There’s really no need for you to be dressed like that and you’re making me uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 你能不能先……套件外套什么的？你真没必要穿成那样，你让我很不舒服。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom29
: You’ve seen these mosquito bites up close and personal before. Or at least close enough to know they ain’t a threat. Just tell yourself I’m a boy or somethin’. I don’t care.
lines.zh: : 你之前近距离见过这几颗蚊子包。或者至少近到知道它们不构成威胁。就当我是个男的什么的。我不在乎。

lines.en: : I still feel like a jacket would be a demonstrably easier solution when the alternative is asking {i}me{/i} to convince {i}myself{/i} of anything.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}还是觉得套个外套明显是更简单的解决办法，而另一种方案是要求我去说服{i}自己{/i}相信任何事。

lines.en: : Baring one’s body before another before the sun sets is a sin that can only be redeemed by the flaying of one’s skin.
lines.zh: : 日落之前在另一个人面前袒露身体，是一种只能用剥皮来赎的罪。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom30
: Agreed.
lines.zh: : 同意。

lines.en: : Ain’t your religion thing the one where a guy’s gotta splooge in a girl to cure ‘em of devil AIDS or somethin’? Can that only be done at night?
lines.zh: : 你们那个宗教不就是讲男的得射在女的里面、治好她们的「恶魔艾滋」什么的吗？那只能在晚上做？

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom31

: The act of transference shan’t be misconstrued with recreational sex as it is done for the sole purpose of preserving humanity and protecting those who would normally partake in it from what is sure to come.
lines.zh: : 不可把「传递」之举曲解为消遣式的性行为，因为它唯一的目的在于保全人类、保护那些本会参与其中的人免遭必将到来的事。

lines.en: : So the splooge gives girls some kinda energy shield?
lines.zh: : 所以那玩意儿给女孩套了层能量护盾？

lines.en: : Can you stop saying “splooge” please?
lines.zh: : 你能不能别再说「那玩意儿」了？

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom32
: It is more like the splooge connects one entity to a greater one and subsequently marks them as worthy of redemption.
lines.zh: : 更像是那玩意儿把一个个体连接到一个更大的存在，随即把他们标记为值得救赎。

lines.en: : Can {i}you{/i} stop saying “splooge” please?!
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}能不能别再说「那玩意儿」了？！

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom33
: What’s all the complainin’ for? Ain’t nobody sploogin’ on you, Io. And as the self-proclaimed splooge expert of the room, I ain’t changin’ for nobody.
lines.zh: : 抱怨个什么劲？又没人往你身上射，Io。而且作为本房间的自称射精专家，我是不会为任何人改口的。

lines.en: : This is great news! It will make saving you easier! We must find Sensei at once!
lines.zh: : 这是个好消息！那会让我更容易拯救你！我们必须立刻找到 Sensei！

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom34
: Now, hold your friggin’ horsecock, Yasu. It ain’t nearly as easy as you think. There are certain...complication’s a girl’s gotta figure out how to deal with first.
lines.zh: : 现在，先别急，Yasu。这事没你想的那么容易。有些……复杂状况，一个女孩得先想办法处理。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom35
: {b}HE CARES NOT FOR THE NARROW CREVICE THAT LIVES BETWEEN YOUR LEGS AND BECKONS THAT YOU BE TORN IN HALF TO SATE THE LUST OF THE CHOSEN ONE!!!{b}
lines.zh: : {b}他不在乎那条活在你两腿之间、召唤着你被撕裂成两半以满足「被选中者」欲望的狭窄缝隙！！！{/b}

lines.en: : {b}I WILL TIE YOU TO THE BED MYSELF IF YOUR PATHETIC EXCUSE OF A CUNT IS RELUCTANT TO ACCEPT THE PHALLIC INVITATION OF HE WHO FUCKED THE WORLD ITSELF!!!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}要是你那可悲的屄不愿意接受「操了整个世界之人」的阳具邀请，我就亲手把你绑到床上！！！{/b}

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom36
: I’m sorry. I think it’s time for me to take my medication again.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我想我又该吃药了。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom37
: Phallic invitation?
lines.zh: : 阳具邀请？

lines.en: : Sorry for more sex talk, but it’s gonna be weird as hell when Sensei bones that girl.
lines.zh: : 抱歉又聊到性，不过等 Sensei 上了那个女孩的时候，场面绝对会诡异到极点。

lines.en: : I feel like she’s either going to burst into flames or grow wings. I don’t think there will be a middle ground.
lines.zh: : 我感觉她要么会自燃，要么会长出翅膀。我觉得不会有中间地带。

lines.en: scene black
: I don’t even like girls, but I kinda wanna see it.
lines.zh: : 我连女孩都不喜欢，可我有点想看。

lines.en: : Well, count me out. Want a cookie? Uta and I made them before the party.
lines.zh: : 嗯，别算我。要饼干吗？派对前我和 Uta 做的。

lines.en: : You didn’t drug ‘em, did you? Kinda scared of takin’ anything from you after ya kickstarted my wildly unpopular drug addiction arc.
lines.zh: : 你没往里面下药吧？在你一手开启我那段极不受欢迎的毒瘾剧情之后，我还真有点怕从你手里拿任何东西。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom38
: Oh, Yasu. What were you doing in there? The party’s on the second floor.
lines.zh: : 哦，Yasu。你刚才在里面干什么？派对在二楼。

lines.en: : You didn’t accept some stranger’s invitation did you?
lines.zh: : 你没接受哪个陌生人的邀请吧？

lines.en: : Not this time. I was just doing what Touka said and trying to stay out of trouble, but I’m afraid that I may have accidentally created some again by being so worthless and broken.
lines.zh: : 这次没有。我只是照 Touka 说的做，尽量不惹麻烦，但我怕我又因为这么没用、这么破碎，不小心制造出了新的麻烦。

lines.en: : I’m sure it wasn’t that bad. What happened?
lines.zh: : 我确信没那么糟。发生什么了？

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom39
: I probably shouldn’t say...it’s very inappropriate, I think...
lines.zh: : 我大概不该说……我想那非常不合适……

lines.en: : I’m sure I’ve heard ten times worse from Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我确信我从 Sensei 那儿听过比这糟十倍的话。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ve {i}said{/i} ten times worse.
lines.zh: : 我确信你{i}说{/i}过比这糟十倍的话。

lines.en: : Either way, things slip sometimes, Yasu. It happens. I doubt it’s anything you need to get hung up on.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，人有时候会嘴瓢，Yasu。这种事会发生的。我怀疑那不值得你挂在心上。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom40
: Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : It’s {i}okay{/i} that I felt compelled to comment on the size of Miku’s vagina and how happy it would make God if Sensei were to have his way with her while I tied her to the bed?...
lines.zh: : 我忍不住评论了 Miku 那地方的size，还说如果 Sensei 能对她为所欲为、而我同时把她绑在床上，神会有多高兴——这也{i}没关系{/i}吗？……

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom41
: Okay. Time to go.
lines.zh: : 好了。该走了。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom42
: W-Wait a second, Akira! If Yasu’s on the verge of having another {i}Yasu{/i} attack, shouldn’t we maybe take her with us? You know, so nothing {i}worse{/i} happens?
lines.zh: : 等……等一下，Akira！如果 {i}Yasu{/i} 又快发作了，我们是不是该把她一起带走？你知道的，免得{i}更糟{/i}的事发生？

lines.en: : I’m sorry I’m always causing trouble for you. I don’t understand why I’m like this...
lines.zh: : 抱歉我总是给你添麻烦。我不明白我为什么会这样……

lines.en: : I will not burden you by following you into the dark. I just ask that you do not tell Touka about this. She’d be so disappointed in me...
lines.zh: : 我不会跟着你走进黑暗里，成为你的负担。我只求你别把这事告诉 Touka。她会对我很失望的……

lines.en: : We can’t leave her when she looks like {i}that,{/i} right?
lines.zh: : 她{i}那副样子{/i}，我们不能丢下她吧？

lines.en: : Ayane...you {i}do{/i} remember what we stepped aside to talk about, right? And how incorporating Yasu into that discussion would obviously make things even {i}more{/i} convoluted?
lines.zh: : Ayane……你{i}还{/i}记得我们特意走到一边是要谈什么吧？以及把 Yasu 也拉进那场讨论，显然会让事情{i}更加{/i}错综复杂？

lines.en: : It’s okay...I’ll just go find a dumpster to crawl into and lock myself inside until the voices quiet down.
lines.zh: : 没关系……我会自己去找个垃圾箱钻进去、把自己锁在里面，直到那些声音安静下来。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom43
: But if you could maybe come and unlock it if I can’t get myself out by tomorrow morning, I’d be very grateful...
lines.zh: : 不过要是明天早上我自己出不来，你能不能来帮我开一下锁，我会非常感激……

lines.en: : Seriously, though. How does she look so cute while saying such miserable things?
lines.zh: : 说真的。她怎么说得出这么惨的话，还能这么可爱？

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom44
: {i}Hah...{/i}I don’t know, Ayane. I feel like this is something we should probably just keep between us, Makoto, and Yumi.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}我不知道，Ayane。我觉得这事大概只该留在我、你、Makoto 和 Yumi 之间。

lines.en: : Wrapping Yasu up in it on top of everything {i}else{/i} she has going on just seems kind of cruel.
lines.zh: : 在 Yasu 已经有{i}那么多事{/i}要应付的情况下，再把她裹进来，似乎有点残忍。

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom45

: {size=-2}Then...maaaaaybe we can hold off on our “holy shit, what is going on?” talk for a little while? Like...until the party is over maybe? Like, there’s no need to {i}rush,{/i} right? We have all the time in the world!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}那么……我……我们能不能把那场「我操，到底发生了什么」的对话往后拖一拖？比如……等到派对结束？比如，没必要{i}着急{/i}，对吧？我们有的是时间！{/size}

lines.en: : Hahah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……

lines.en: : Ayane — what did Ami say to you when you guys were talking earlier? Because your attitude’s been a little different ever since-
lines.zh: : Ayane——你们之前聊天的时候 Ami 跟你说了什么？因为从那之后你的态度就有点不一样了——

lines.en: scene yasuquietroom46
: C...Come on, Yasuyasu! Let’s take you somewhere you can rant and rave without the fear of your peers judging you for it!
lines.zh: : 来……来吧，Yasuyasu！我们带你去个地方，让你可以尽情又吼又骂，不用担心同龄人因此评判你！

lines.en: scene black
It’s pretty clear that something Ami said {i}did{/i} get to Ayane. And I’m sure I’ll squeeze it out of her sooner rather than later.
lines.zh: 很明显，Ami 说的某句话{i}确实{/i}刺激到 Ayane 了。而我确信我迟早会把它从她嘴里榨出来。

lines.en: I just hope she doesn’t get to Maya next...
lines.zh: 我只是希望她别接着去找 Maya……

$ yasu_love += 1
{i}Yasu’s affection has increased to [yasu_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Yasu 的好感度提升到了 [yasu_love]!{/i}
